panel-icon-size-color.tooltip: Never larger than the panel allows.

panel-icon-size-symbolic.tooltip: Never larger than the panel allows.

active-indicator.description: Panel icon while a preview runs

usage-indicator.description: Show when a program uses a camera
usage-indicator.tooltip: Red dot on the panel icon and a line in the menu. aVinceCam only watches the camera device files; it does not open them.

preview-viewer.tooltip: For libcamera cameras. USB cameras use VLC if it is installed, otherwise GStreamer.

snapshot-size.tooltip: Built-in cameras are often soft at full size; 1600 × 1200 keeps their detail in a smaller file. USB cameras use the closest size they offer.

snapshot-folder.tooltip: Empty: the pictures folder, subfolder aVinceCam.

allow-lens-cameras.description: Allow preview of cameras with a focus motor
allow-lens-cameras.tooltip: Preview, photo and virtual camera of such cameras. aVinceCam runs them without libcamera's autofocus: the focus motor is not moved and the focus stays fixed.

use-libcamera-autofocus.tooltip: libcamera then moves the focus motor while the camera streams. Only switch this on if the focus motor works: if it does not answer, every attempt ends up as an error in the system log.
